entry_route.value: Applicants can enter from a computer science master's or straight from a computer science bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Students may apply for the PhD program after completing their MS degree in computer science or proceed directly to PhD program after completing their BS degree in computer science.

gre_general.value: The computer science department does not require the GRE General test.

gre_subject.value: No subject test is named for computer science.

supervisor.value: The page sets a committee of four, with a supervisor, but no rule for admission.

funding.value: The page gives no funding rule.

deadline.value: The page gives no application deadline.

notes: The Computer Engineering PhD in the same department (catalog.uta.edu/engineering/computer/graduate/computer-engineering-phd/) also says GRE General not required. An international applicant whose native language is not English 'may be required to submit English proficiency scores' (catalog).
